headline: UPDF gunfight in Sajek: 3,000 tourists trapped as armed group fires on convoy
summary: The Bangladesh Army and police have evacuated over 2,300 tourists after armed UPDF members fired 30-40 shots at a tourist convoy and security forces in Rangamati.
details: Armed members of the United Peoples Democratic Front (UPDF) fired approximately 30-40 shots at tourists and security forces in the Gangaram Bazar area of Sajek, Rangamati, on Thursday morning.
The attack occurred while the Bangladesh Army and police were attempting to safely evacuate tourists who had been trapped by a road blockade created by the UPDF using local people as human shields.

According to the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), the situation escalated after security forces attempted to negotiate with the blockade's organizers. The attackers then began throwing bricks and stones before opening fire.
The Bangladesh Army responded with retaliatory fire to ensure the safety of tourists and for self-defense, causing the armed group to flee the scene.
Following the clash, security forces successfully evacuated the trapped tourists to Khagrachhari. No casualties were reported in the incident.
The ISPR stated that the incident was pre-planned and expressed concern over the UPDF's use of local citizens as human shields to disrupt peace and stability in the Chittagong Hill Tracts.
The Sajek Valley tourist center has been temporarily closed by the district administration until further notice due to security concerns.

headline_marked: Man [[beaten to death over child abduction suspicion]] at Dhaka hospital
headline: Man beaten to death over child abduction suspicion at Dhaka hospital
summary: A 41-year-old man, suspected of being a child lifter, was killed by a mob at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital on Wednesday night.
details: A 41-year-old man named Alam Sheikh was beaten to death by a crowd at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital in Dhaka on Wednesday night.
The incident occurred around 11 PM when Sheikh was seen wandering near the hospital's pediatric ward. When questioned by the relatives of patients, he was unable to provide a satisfactory answer.
A group of people then dragged him down from the hospital building and beat him severely, leading to his death on the spot.
Police responded to a 999 emergency call and recovered the body. After verifying fingerprints, police identified the victim as a resident of Rupnagar, Dhaka.
The family of the deceased has claimed that Alam Sheikh suffered from mental instability.
One person has been detained by the police in connection with the incident.
caption:
A man was beaten to death at a Dhaka hospital after being suspected of child abduction.

A 41-year-old man named Alam Sheikh was beaten to death by a crowd at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital in Dhaka on Wednesday night.

The incident occurred around 11 PM when Sheikh was seen wandering near the hospital's pediatric ward. When questioned by the relatives of patients, he was unable to provide a satisfactory answer.

A group of people then dragged him down from the hospital building and beat him severely, leading to his death on the spot.

Police responded to a 999 emergency call and recovered the body. After verifying fingerprints, police identified the victim as a resident of Rupnagar, Dhaka.

The family of the deceased has claimed that Alam Sheikh suffered from mental instability.

One person has been detained by the police in connection with the incident.
